servicesPage.label: SERVICES
servicesPage.title: Four disciplines, one crew
servicesPage.intro: From advertising to production, everything runs under one roof. No brief gets lost between agencies.

serviceDetailPage.ctaBody: Leave a short message and let's talk through the right approach for you.

google-seo.title: Google SEO
google-seo.tagline: First page, on the right keywords
google-seo.intro: Your customers should find you when they search on Google. From technical foundations to content strategy, we optimize your site end to end for search engines and build lasting visibility on the keywords that matter.
points: Technical SEO audit and site-speed optimization

meta-reklamlari.title: Meta Ads
meta-reklamlari.tagline: Targeted reach on Facebook and Instagram
meta-reklamlari.intro: We put Meta's ad ecosystem to work for the right audience at the right budget. From campaign setup to creative production, we manage every step and turn every dollar into a measurable result.

tiktok-reklamlari.title: TikTok Ads
tiktok-reklamlari.tagline: Stand out in a younger audience's feed
tiktok-reklamlari.intro: We make ads that fit TikTok's nature and don't feel like ads. We translate the platform's trends into your brand's voice and run performance campaigns without breaking the organic feel.

youtube-reklamlari.title: YouTube Ads
youtube-reklamlari.tagline: Video ads built for results, not just views
youtube-reklamlari.intro: We get the right format in front of the right viewer on YouTube. From skippable ads to bumpers, we craft every format to capture your brand story in the first second.

web-tasarimi.title: Web Design
web-tasarimi.tagline: A site that reflects your brand and converts
web-tasarimi.intro: Not templates — web experiences designed specifically for your brand. Fast, mobile-friendly and search-engine ready, with flows that turn visitors into customers.

web-otomasyonlari.title: Web Automation
web-otomasyonlari.tagline: Hand repetitive work over to the system
web-otomasyonlari.intro: We connect processes like forms, email, booking, payments and reporting, and take manual work off your plate. Your team spends time on the work itself, not the operations.

crm.title: CRM
crm.intro: We move your customer relationships from scattered spreadsheets into a single system. We set up the sales funnel, follow-up steps and reports so no opportunity slips away.

yapay-zeka.title: Artificial Intelligence
yapay-zeka.intro: From content production to customer service, we adapt AI to the real needs of your business. Not an off-the-shelf tool, but a solution that fits your process.

sosyal-medya.title: Social Media
sosyal-medya.tagline: A consistent, planned voice that's yours
sosyal-medya.intro: We run your social accounts end to end, from content planning to community management. Instead of chasing trends, we build your brand's own voice and amplify it steadily.

reklam-filmi.title: Commercial Film
reklam-filmi.tagline: A cinematic story that tells your brand
reklam-filmi.intro: From concept to edit, we produce commercial films with our own directing crew. Script, shoot and post-production under one roof — no subcontractor chain, a consistent result.

video-cekimi.title: Video Production
video-cekimi.intro: Promo, product, event or social; we shoot the video content you need with professional equipment. The crew on set is ours, the responsibility is single.

fotograf-cekimi.title: Photography
fotograf-cekimi.tagline: Show your brand in the right frame
fotograf-cekimi.intro: We deliver product, location, corporate and event photography at studio quality. We compose and retouch every frame to fit your brand's visual language.

kisa-film.title: Short Film
kisa-film.tagline: A brand story told with emotion
kisa-film.intro: We produce story-driven short films that go deeper than an ad. We turn your brand's values into a narrative and build an emotional connection with the audience.

reji-hizmeti.title: Broadcast Direction
reji-hizmeti.intro: We direct your events, launches and live streams with our own crew. Multi-camera setup, real-time editing and broadcast flow, all from a single source.

about.label: Why Us?
about.heading:
Not an ad agency —
your brand's digital partner.
about.intro: Unlike a classic advertising agency, we exist to be the digital partner of the businesses we work with. Our core goal is to grow the brands beside us and turn that growth into real revenue.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: When they grow, we grow.
vision.body: Our digital partners have to grow for us to grow. If a business is scaling because of us, it proves we're good at what we do. Their success is, directly, our success.

mission.label: Mission
mission.title: The best work, quietly done.
mission.body: Running a brand's PR at its best means running our own PR at its best. We manage your digital presence so well that the results speak for us.

about.quote: “Who runs your digital operations? They're really good.”
about.quoteCaption: When a client is asked that and points to us — that's our greatest reference.

approach.label: Our Approach
approach.title: We don't just run ads.
approach.body: Beyond producing social content, we manage a business's entire digital operation end to end. We use AI where it matters most and back our content with our own shoots.

web.title: Web & SEO
web.body: Your full digital foundation, from the website to technical SEO.

content.title: Content & Production
content.body: Content creation fed by our own shoots and production.

ads.title: Performance Ads
ads.body: Meta and Google Ads planned and managed end to end.

geo.title: GEO & AI
geo.body: GEO and AI used at the exact point they benefit your brand.

direction.title: Direction & Events
direction.body: Direction and production for concerts, events and organizations.

operations.title: Digital Operations
operations.body: The capability to run every digital operation you can think of.
